generations.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity screenshot of the Chinese Fouc project WORKBENCH HOMEPAGE, direction "工作桌面". This is a real desktop software landing page for multiple ongoing work items, NOT an editor, a dashboard poster, a collage, or a presentation. Full app screenshot, straight on, about 1600 x 1000 pixels, no external caption, no device frame.

REFERENCE INPUT: the attached image is the actual Fouc shell. Use it ONLY to preserve the exact existing app shell geometry, material, icon silhouettes, project identity, navigation, system toolbar and footer. Replace ALL old dashboard content. Do not copy its chart, KPI cards, meetings, team panel or old project cards. Preserve ordinary 100% desktop UI scale: sidebar 272px (17% of total width), system topbar 44px, tab height 32px. Main white application surface begins x272,y44, rounded outer 16px corners, one crisp pale edge. Do not enlarge the controls to match image size.

SHELL: same light Fouc application: very pale neutral sidebar #f9f9f9; white main surface; graphite Chinese sans-serif typography, 13px body and controls, 12px secondary metadata, max 18–22px headings, 30px buttons, 20px avatars. Project at top left reads exactly "Fouc 桌面端 V1". The ONLY project selector is this existing top-left control. Sidebar has "新对话", "工作台" selected in the existing light-gray neutral selected row, "任务", "成员", "资产", "智能体"; below divider "频道" then a small purple hashtag "产品与设计"; below "最近" and "暂无最近对话". Footer "社区", "连接器", avatar "Fouc Admin", dark-mode moon and settings. Same FA7 Solid gray icon silhouettes as shell; actions use simple familiar light controls. System top has sidebar toggle, history arrows, active "工作台" tab and its x, plus tab, search and task icons, Windows minimize/maximize/close. No workspace entity, knowledge base, automation module, permanent chat pane or right inspector.

ART DIRECTION: premium crafted contemporary SOFTWARE work desk. Calm neutral white and almost-white gray document preview surfaces; meticulous thin single borders, sharp rendering, 10px card radii, no stacked shadows, no faux 3D, no illustration, no colorful brand theme. Workflow colors only appear in tiny type icons or small badges: design muted cyan, debugging muted rose, research small blue, writing neutral graphite. Beautiful deliberate spacing and cropped document CONTENT gives tactile interest, not decorative texture. Main title stays modest, not a hero. Typography and material should look like professionally designed production software.

COMPOSITION, very important:
1. ONE compact page toolbar from y44–92 within main surface: left "工作台" at 19px then a quiet 12px date "2026年11月12日 周四". Right a small text "当前项目" if useful is unnecessary; do NOT repeat the project selector. Right only one restrained black 30px button "+ 新建工作" and a subtle compact overflow control. No second header, breadcrumbs, tabs, filters or status bands.
2. FIRST useful content begins around y108, 24px horizontal padding. One compact 52px human-attention ribbon across the content width: a tiny restrained amber dot and label "需要你" then two horizontally separated concise items. First "确认邀请重发规则" with microcontext "ADR-012 · 两个方案已备齐" and text action "查看决定 →". Second "复审任务批量调整" with microcontext "修复轮次 2 · 证据已更新" and text action "进入复审 →". A single fine neutral border, pale neutral background, subtle vertical divider, not two large warning cards. These actions enter dedicated pages; no approve/reject checkboxes.
3. A small heading "继续工作" with quiet right link "全部工作 6 →" around y185. Below it an ASYMMETRIC carefully proportioned collection of FOUR work entry surfaces. This is NOT four equal tiles and NOT nested dashboard widgets. A wider dominant DESIGN surface top left (about 740w x 350h), a narrower DEBUG surface top right (about 480w x 350h), then RESEARCH bottom left (about 580w x 250h), WRITING bottom right (about 640w x 250h). Gaps about 16px. They form a sophisticated work desk, clearly different in widths and document content. All four are home entry cards, not actual live editors. No toolbar per document preview. Keep card body about 13px and actual preview paragraphs about 12px. Headers have tiny type marker, ID, activity and small time; useful excerpt in center; compact person and next-action footer. All four have compact metadata with responsible human/Agent and current activity; all are within the current project.

CARD CONTENT verbatim important labels and useful credible preview:
A. Dominant design card:
tiny top metadata "FUC-42"  "特性开发"  "详细设计" and time "12 分钟前".
Title "成员邀请与权限" at 18px max. One concise state line "邀请重发规则待确认 · design.md v3".
Flat document preview with small gray file line "design.md  /  邀请流程".
Preview content heading "邀请重发规则".
A short compact content excerpt:
"已存在待接受邀请时，保留原角色并更新有效期。"
"重发仅通知当前邮箱，历史邀请链接立即失效。"
Tiny highlighted document comment near excerpt "待确认  重发间隔：24 小时 / 立即重发" with restrained amber left edge; this is source context, NOT a standalone third task or large sticky note. A small version metadata at bottom of preview "v3 · 林悦更新".
Footer with a 20px avatar and "林悦" left; one small black 30px next action "继续设计 →" right. It routes into the work.

B. Narrow debugging card:
"FUC-38"  "问题修复"  "复现与定位".
Title "设备会话断连".
State "已复现；等待验证根因".
Cropped reproduction-record preview with heading "复现记录" and three compact numbered lines:
"1 连接设备并启动会话"
"2 网络中断后恢复连接"
"3 会话未自动恢复"
One small pale-gray monospaced excerpt line "session: disconnected → reconnecting".
Footer a small neutral Agent avatar icon and "Codex"; next action "查看进展 →". Avoid a terminal window or full logs.

C. Research card:
"FUC-45"  "只读调研"  "调研结论".
Title "连接器权限审计".
State "3 项发现待审阅".
A cropped concise mini-document preview with 3 true findings, using small numbered labels and short lines:
"01 读写权限需要分别授权"
"02 凭据应绑定具体设备连接"
"03 操作需记录资源与授权来源"
Footer 20px avatar "陈宁"; small neutral action "查看结论 →".

D. Writing card:
"FUC-46"  "文档工作"  "正文草稿".
Title "项目活动摘要".
State "基于本周已确认的交付记录".
A small credible writing outline fragment:
"本周交付"
"  1. 项目成员邀请体验"
"  2. 连接器权限审计"
"下一步"
"  独立复审与真实旅程验证"
Use fine spacing and modest typographic indentation; no rich text toolbar.
Footer 20px avatar "林悦"; action "继续编写 →".

4. Low around y900 a QUIET flat text row, separated by one fine horizontal rule, label "最近完成的交付". Two compact inline records: green tiny check "连接器权限审计 · 3 项发现已提交" and green tiny check "成员邀请与权限 · 设计 v3 已更新". Small muted times. These are completed source artifacts within ongoing work, not a conflicting claim that whole work items are finished. No new cards, no giant completion summary.
5. Give the bottom of main surface a little calm breathing room. No scrollbar if content fits. No floating robot/chat button.

QUALITY AND SEMANTIC CONSTRAINTS: multiple work items, precise next actions and two human checkpoints. Activities are flexible revisitable labels, never ten mandatory columns, progress percent, traffic KPI or stage wall. Stage, role, skill, run and evidence are not mixed. Research and writing are first-class work types. Root-cause work can start at reproduction. Evidence gates require evidence and reviewer; home actions route into pages. All sample content is illustrative UX, not execution evidence. Use neutral navigation/actions; color only for workflow meaning, status, warning, success or links. Every edge is one clean line; no shadow-on-shadow, giant command prompt, huge greeting, oversized title, decorative chart, fake marketing artwork, right panel or repeated project chooser. The result must feel a polished Fouc HOME with four different work entry previews at the correct compact production UI density.
